title: Silsila Hai Pyar Ka
desc: Vanshika, a simple young woman, is hired by a wealthy man to care for his son. Though the boy is spoiled at first, her presence slowly changes his outlook and their lives forever.

title: Sandwich
desc: Sher Singh juggles life with his two wives, Nisha and Sweety, but when they unexpectedly meet, his troubles multiply, leading to a series of hilarious situations.

desc: Adi plans a grand charity concert with Magik, his rock band, but constant opposition from local authorities throws hurdles in their path to make it happen.
